snippet.title: Inner City Unit Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Inner City Unit is an upcoming first person immersive sim about the narcotics trade in the surveillance city-state of Annexia. As an agent of an intelligence outfit, assume the identity of Albert Buchanan - part-time writer, part-time narcotics dealer. Procure product, push it across the city, don't get made.

PLAY THE DEMO: https://opulentrecordings.itch.io/inner-city-unit

WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3506450/Inner_City_Unit/
